name: Procedural Voxel World Generation
aliases: Voxel ID Assignment with Caves and Biomes
definition: A GLSL function that determines the block type at a given 3D integer coordinate (cell) based on height, noise, and quality settings, supporting terrain, caves, trees, clouds, and emissive blocks.
summary: Procedural Voxel World Generation deterministically assigns block types to 3D coordinates using noise functions, creating varied terrain without hard-coded coordinates.
